description: Run every automatic check of your proposal and store the verdicts: its schema, the competition it composes, its prizes (placement only, within this server's floor and ceiling and the escrow's cap), its schedule (competition.duration_hours at least the shortest entries window; make.fun sets the opening, the review hours from now at the soonest, the deadline and the final window from it), its category, no uploaded files, its rules reviewed since the make.fun team finished a custom setup, on a code bounty the test pack its harness names (held to the record the team built for this proposal: nothing of yours to change, the team fixes a failing one), the wallet (read on chain: it holds the pot and the SOL the deposit takes) and your account's proposal limits. Answers {proposal, problem}: the proposal (status ready when every check passed, else needs_fix; a custom brief's draft once every one but the template's passed, which proposal_deposit then funds) and the RFC 9457 problem a deposit would be refused with (null when every check passed), every check with its reason and each failed one with its fix. Signed in only, your own proposals: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401, and another account's proposal 404.

proposal_id.description: The proposal's id (a UUID): proposal_create answers it as id; GET /api/sponsor/proposals lists yours

name: proposal_checks
title: Run a proposal's checks
